title: Export scheduled jobs from Housecall Pro
status: draft: narration follows the platform's help article; check every line against the recording before narrating
sampleData: The platform's authorized demo account with sample clients only. No real names, emails, phone numbers, account ids or payment details on screen.

scenes.narration: This shows how to export your upcoming jobs from Housecall Pro.
Click Jobs in the left navigation bar. Click Edit columns, and include the customer, the scheduled date and the address.
Click Filter, set the scheduled date to the weeks ahead, then click Apply.
Click Actions in the top right, then Export, then Send file.
Return to Selestial and upload the file you just downloaded.

capture.what: Open the email, download the CSV.
